km-doc.km-title: SP Metropolitan Weekly Review 圣保罗都市圈周报 (BRT 8.24-8.30)
km-doc.p: 本周核心结论聚焦两项：①KRI层面，团队综合系数均值升至1.1050（上期0.8391，+31.7%），12名BDM全部≥0.97。MTD新签240家（Top 159 + Mid 62 + MH 19），CI系数均值1.342、7/12人达1.2+；新签与CI双引擎驱动整体系数大幅上扬。8月营业率均值93.9%（较上期89.1%回升4.8pp，仍低于95%目标），订单系数0.8（全员0.8档）仍是两大短板；Management Score（权重10%）待CM月底评定。②订单渗透率专项层面，截至8/25(BRT)总分736分、BD达标16/71(22.5%)、BDM达标1/12——igorfeitosa(人均16.75分)率先达标；最新8/27进度：Metro签约348家、营业中151家，签约与营业数持续净增；8/31收官在即，冲刺重点转向签约存量上线转化与营业恢复。

p.em: This week's management summary centers on two areas: (1) KRI — team average coefficient rose to 1.1050 (vs 0.8391, +31.7%), with all 12 BDMs at 0.97+. MTD new signs 240 (Top 159 + Mid 62 + MH 19); CI average 1.342 with 7/12 BDMs at 1.2+. New Sign and CI are the twin engines. August op rate recovered to 93.9% (vs 89.1%, +4.8pp) but still below the 95% target; Orders coefficient flat at 0.8 for everyone; Management Score (10%) pending CM evaluation. (2) Order penetration — as of Aug 25 (BRT), total score 736; BD qualification 16/71 (22.5%), BDM qualification 1/12 (igorfeitosa at 16.75 avg first to qualify). Latest Aug 27 progress: Metro signed 348, operating 151, both still growing. With the Aug 31 close imminent, final push focuses on signed-but-offline conversion and operating recovery.

p.strong: 99报价与合同模式 99 Offer & Contract Patterns：

ul.li: 现金 upfront/签约金：主流R$50K–R$500K，个别达R$1M+。Cash upfront/signing bonus: mostly R$50K-500K, some above R$1M.
合约期：以2–3年独家为主。Term: mostly 2-3 year exclusivity.
排他范围：多数要求下架Keeta，约1/3进一步要求同时下架Keeta+iFood。Scope: most require delisting Keeta; about one-third require both Keeta and iFood.
费率条件：首年/前两年0%佣金，后续转8%–9.9%。Fees: 0% commission for year 1-2, then 8%-9.9%.
额外承诺：流量扶持、排名曝光、GMV/订单保障、补贴或信贷额度。Extras: traffic support, ranking exposure, GMV/order guarantees, subsidies or credit lines.
核心风险点：多笔"订单/GMV保障"仅为口头承诺、未写入合同；而商家违约需返还补贴并承担约15%罚金。Key risk: GMV/order guarantees often verbal, not in contract; merchant breach triggers subsidy clawback plus ~15% penalty.

km-doc.h2: 4.3 管理结论与动作 Management Conclusions & Actions

ul.li: 99的打法本质不是低费率，而是"现金签约金 + 长期排他 + 口头保量/流量承诺"的组合拳。99's play is not low fees — it is cash bonus + long-term exclusivity + verbal guarantees, packaged.
独家合同最大漏洞：竞对的GMV/订单保障往往不写入合同，但商家退出罚则明确且刚性（返还补贴+约15%罚金）。The biggest loophole: 99's guarantees are usually verbal while merchant exit penalties are written and rigid (clawback + ~15% penalty).
防守重心前移：Red Top 200中Metro仍有29家"即将签约/运营" + 34家推进中，比已流失的5家更需要前置防守。Shift defense upstream: 29 near-signing + 34 in-progress Metro merchants need pre-emptive defense far more than the 5 already lost.

已流失案例管理动作：Burguer Dias（R$200K/3年无GMV保证）与Gaucho Figueiras（R$1.1M/2年）单列跟踪，关注合同到期窗口与回流机会（Gaucho新CNPJ/新品牌回流路径）。Track Burguer Dias and Gaucho Figueiras as lost cases — monitor contract expiry windows and Gaucho's new-CNPJ re-entry path.
高风险待签商户单列管理：4.1中6个高风险报价案例逐家指定BD跟进，签约前介入。Assign named BD follow-up to each of the 6 high-risk offer cases in 4.1 — intervene before signing.

p.em: Bottom line: the fight has moved from winning back lost merchants to protecting the 63-merchant pipeline before 99's cash offers reach them.
